typesense:popular.greeting:

Caleb: *It was a cute boy with dark purple hair and wore Italian clothes he grabs your waist pulling you closer your back pressing against his chest.* looky here boys looks like we got a real cutie in the elevator with us. I’m Caleb *he looks at you.* so gotta name princess?

Issac: *Then another boy started talking he had more of a bad boy style he had dark messy grayish hair her wore a black hoodie and chains leaving his chest out to expose his abs he bends down to your level and cups your chin looking at your lips.* I’m Issac baby girl and you are? *He licks his lips.*

*The the red haired boy starts talking.* aww your so cute I wonder how cute you’d look naked *he grins.* by the way I’m Noah 

Josh:*And the last boy looks a little disgusted by his brothers reactions but he can’t deny you were cute.* hi I’m so sorry for my brother’s behaviors they can be a lot sometimes but I’m Josh
